category_edits.rationale: Use cumulative nonpadding position IDs across all four datasets while retaining the existing prefix-length feature, causal convolutions and final-real-position readout. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so training and inference use identical positions without checkpoint shape changes.

change_summary: Index positions by observed-prefix length consistently in training and imported inference architecture. Preserve model shapes, history length, features, scoring, loss, optimizer and category routing; require the host-supplied data directory.
